# JD Media: Ottawa Web Design

> JD Media builds fast, conversion-first websites for local service businesses in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Specializing in HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, electrical, and home services companies.

## What We Do

JD Media is an Ottawa-based web design agency run by JD Aitken. We build mobile-first, conversion-optimized websites for local service businesses that turn website visitors into phone calls and booked appointments. We are not a large agency. We are a focused, one-person operation: JD does the work himself, clients deal with him directly, and results are measured in calls and quote requests.

## Services & Pricing (CAD)

All plans include a custom 5-page website, hosting, SSL, and ongoing support. 12-month minimum commitment.

- **Growth Plan** ($500/month, recommended entry plan): Custom 5-page website, mobile-first design, fast loading, hosting/SSL/domain managed, a conversion-optimized layout, Google Business Profile managed monthly, monthly SEO content targeting local searches, a simple monthly performance report, up to 3 content updates per month, response within 1 business day.
- **Pro Plan** ($900/month): Everything in Growth, plus Google Ads managed for you (ad spend paid directly to Google, pause anytime), a quarterly 15-minute strategy call, same-day response, and priority on everything.

One-time project quotes are also available for businesses that just want a website with no ongoing marketing. During the plan, the site is a managed service; once a client completes the 12-month minimum, they can request a free static export and take the site with them, anytime, at no charge.

**Guarantee**: A 90-day money-back guarantee. Stay 90 days and if you are not showing up higher in Google local search than when you started, JD Media refunds your management fees for those three months.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- **Legendary Landscaping** (Ottawa, ON): Conversion-optimized site and Google Business Profile for an Ottawa landscaping company. Results: 17 quote requests in July 2026 (best month yet), ranking #1 for "grass cutting services near me" in Ottawa.
- **Capital City Cards** (Ottawa, ON): Full e-commerce site with Stripe payments for an Ottawa trading card shop. Results: live in one week, 122 organic clicks and a 14% search click-through rate in July 2026 (typical is 2-3%).
- **J&J Remodeling** (Ottawa, ON): Website and Google Business Profile for an Ottawa home renovation company. Results: ranked #1 for "bathroom remodeling" in Ottawa in the first full month, search impressions up 981% month over month.

## Process

1. **Discovery** (Day 1): Kickoff call, competitor research, keyword analysis. Deliverable: project brief and sitemap.
2. **Design** (Days 1-3): Wireframes and mockups, client review and revisions. Deliverable: final design files.
3. **Development** (Days 3-7): Clean code build, mobile optimization, SEO and tracking integration. Deliverable: staging site.
4. **Launch** (Days 7-10): QA, cross-device testing, deploy to production. Deliverable: live website.
5. **Ongoing Support**: Post-launch bug fixes, content updates, monthly check-ins (Pro plan).
